why: VMID-CASE-1: one rule for the name a person reads, held by the dashboard (VmfHelp.machineName) and the engine (Get-VmfMachineName). Azure gives some resource IDs with the resource group or the machine name in upper case, so a name cut from the ID can show APP-01 for the machine app-01. The records hold the name itself: the capture read from the machine, then the assessment. A recorded name is used only when it is the ID's last part, ignoring case.

cases.case: the capture spells the name, and the ID is in upper case
no capture yet, so the assessment spells the name
no record, so the ID's last part
a recorded name of another machine never renames this one
an empty recorded name is not a name
the capture comes before the assessment when both fit
